analysis.title: PrimeView: AI Degrossing Rotates Back to Semis; Healthcare & Longevity Profit Taking
key_insights: Last Friday's degrossing moved away from Hyperscalers and back to Semis, with selling also reaching the AI Capex basket {UBEQUSAC} and the Optical basket {UBXXOPTC}.
Last week was the third-largest week of degrossing YTD, with gross outflows at 25x the 1Y average.
On Monday, Semis degrossing continued at a much more muted pace (<0.5std). Small dip buying appeared in Memory (+0.5std) and Hardware (+0.7std). Flows are settling ahead of the midterms.
After two consecutive days of heavy systematic selling, UBS Equity Derivs strategy estimates Risk Control strategies turn buyers today, with scope for recovery after.

UBS sees an attractive re-entry setup in Hyperscalers after the midterms, given the pullback in price and positioning, particularly if the event proves to be a clearing catalyst. UBS calls Hyperscalers the higher-quality expression of the AI theme.
US Semis net exposure is back at July lows. Hardware and Memory exposure has kept declining since the summer unwind as hedge funds focused attention and capital on Hyperscalers.
Hedge funds took profits in the Longevity & Wellness basket {UBEQLGLWL} last week after a +6.5% move since 8 October. The basket is a UBS Equity Strategy top-pick.
Healthcare was the third most net sold sector last week on profit taking, after Semis and Media & Entertainment. Healthcare has acted as a defensive counterweight to the AI unwind.
Profit-taking in Healthcare and Longevity & Wellness has run since July, but positioning remains heavily net long in both baskets, with L/S ratios above 4x.
